definitions.full: H1617. Gera גֵּרָא proper name, masculine (Phoenician גרא ) son of Benjamin Gen 46:21 (lacking Num 26:38-40 ); son of Bela`, & grandson of Benjamin, according to 1Chr 8:3 , 5 compare 8:7 ; designation of a Benjamite family or clan; hence Ehud called בֶּןגֵּֿרָא Judg 3:15 , & so Shimei, 2Sam 16:5 ; 19:17 ; 19:19 ; 1Kin 2:8 . גרב (√ of following; Arabic , Aramaic ( have the scab etc.), are apparently denominative)
